finalText:
Found it. The worker was leaking connections on failed order validations.

`processOrder` acquired a DB connection and called `run()`, but if `run()` threw an error, the `pool.release(conn)` never ran. Each invalid order ate a connection permanently. Once all 5 were exhausted, the service crashed.

The fix wraps the code in a try-finally so the release always happens, even on failure—exactly like the API handler already does. All 4 tests pass.
